title: NFL is sending Jaxon Smith-Njigba a new offensive player of year trophy — without the typos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL is sending Jaxon Smith-Njigba a new offensive player of year trophy — without the typos
sources.description: Seahawks receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba said, 'It's getting disrepectful,' in a video in which he showed his offensive player of the year trophy with multiple typos. The NFL has apologized.
